name: Setup OpenSSL
description: Install a pinned OpenSSL build from its GHCR tarballs, verified against its build provenance attestation.

# pretty-yaml-ignore
inputs:
  version:      { description: "OpenSSL release to install, e.g. 4.0.2 or 4.1.0-beta1", required: false, default: "4.0.2"                         }
  artifact:     { description: OCI repository holding the per-platform tarballs,        required: false, default: ghcr.io/kjanat/openssl-prebuilt }
  repository:   { description: Repository whose openssl.yml workflow signed the build,  required: false, default: kjanat/micro509                 }
  source-ref:   { description: Git ref the build must have been published from,         required: false, default: refs/heads/master               }
  token:        { description: Token used to read the build's attestation,              required: false, default: "${{ github.token }}"           }

outputs:
  openssl-path: { description: Path to the installed openssl binary, value: "${{ steps.install.outputs.openssl-path }}" }

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: oras-project/setup-oras@005458ad77f1c8facd38a094e4af2e69e5607ff4 # v2.0.2

    - name: Download, verify, and install OpenSSL
      id: install
      shell: "bash -euo pipefail {0}"
      # pretty-yaml-ignore
      env:
        GH_TOKEN:   ${{ inputs.token      }}
        artifact:   ${{ inputs.artifact   }}
        repository: ${{ inputs.repository }}
        source_ref: ${{ inputs.source-ref }}
        version:    ${{ inputs.version    }}
        os:         ${{ case(runner.os   == 'windows', 'windows', runner.os   == 'macos', 'darwin', runner.os == 'linux', 'linux', runner.os) }}
        arch:       ${{ case(runner.arch == 'x64', 'x64',         runner.arch == 'arm64', 'arm64',  runner.arch) }}
        binary:     ${{ case(runner.os   == 'windows', 'openssl.exe', 'openssl') }}
      run: |
        retry() {
          local attempt status delay=2
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4; do
            if "$@"; then return 0; else status=$?; fi
            if ((attempt == 4)); then return "${status}"; fi
            printf 'Request failed (exit %s); retrying in %ss (attempt %s/4).\n' "${status}" "${delay}" "$((attempt + 1))" >&2
            sleep "${delay}"; delay=$((delay * 2))
          done
        }
        platform="${os}-${arch}"
        if [[ ! "${version}" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-(alpha|beta)[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then
          echo '::error::version must be an OpenSSL release such as 4.0.2 or 4.1.0-beta1.'
          exit 1
        fi

        archive="openssl-${version}-${platform}.tar.gz"
        root="$(mktemp -d "${RUNNER_TEMP//\\//}/openssl.XXXXXXXX")"
        manifest="$(retry oras manifest fetch "${artifact}:${version}")"
        digest="$(jq -r --arg name "${archive}" '.layers[] | select(.annotations["org.opencontainers.image.title"] == $name) | .digest' <<< "${manifest}")"
        if [[ ! "${digest}" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
          echo "::error::${artifact}:${version} has no ${archive}."
          exit 1
        fi
        retry oras blob fetch --output "${root}/${archive}" "${artifact}@${digest}"
        retry gh attestation verify "${root}/${archive}" \
          --repo "${repository}" \
          --signer-workflow "${repository}/.github/workflows/openssl.yml" \
          --source-ref "${source_ref}" \
          --deny-self-hosted-runners
        (cd "${root}" && tar -xzf "${archive}")

        reported="$("${root}/bin/${binary}" version)"
        echo "${reported}"
        case "${reported}" in
          "OpenSSL ${version} "*) ;;
          *) echo "::error::expected OpenSSL ${version}"; exit 1 ;;
        esac

        printf '%s/bin\n'          "${root}"                 >> "${GITHUB_PATH}"
        printf 'OPENSSL_CONF=%s\n' "${root}/ssl/openssl.cnf" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
        printf 'openssl-path=%s\n' "${root}/bin/${binary}"   >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM debian:trixie@sha256:9c6e381421d0f48d1b8133e573f33c185ee16cbf505eda9c4a8a4791b25ea8a6 AS build
ARG BUILDKIT_SBOM_SCAN_STAGE=true
ARG VERSION
ARG SHA256
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]
RUN sed -i -E -e '/^# http:\/\/snapshot\.debian\.org\//{s/^# //;h;d}' -e '/^URIs: /{g;s/^/URIs: /}' /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources \
 && ! grep -E '^URIs: ' /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources | grep -v -E '^URIs: http://snapshot\.debian\.org/archive/' \
 && apt-get -o Acquire::Check-Valid-Until=false update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential=12.12 perl=5.40.1-6+deb13u1 \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ADD --checksum=sha256:${SHA256} https://github.com/openssl/openssl/releases/download/openssl-${VERSION}/openssl-${VERSION}.tar.gz /src/
WORKDIR /src
RUN tar -xzf "openssl-${VERSION}.tar.gz"
WORKDIR /src/openssl-${VERSION}
RUN ./Configure -static --prefix=/usr/local --openssldir=/usr/local/ssl --libdir=lib no-shared no-module no-tests \
 && make -j"$(nproc)" build_sw \
 && make DESTDIR=/out install_sw install_ssldirs

FROM scratch
COPY --from=build /out/usr/local /usr/local
ENV PATH=/usr/local/bin
WORKDIR /w
USER 65534:65534
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/openssl"]
CMD ["version", "-a"]

name: autofix.ci
on: { push: { branches: ["master"] }, pull_request: null, workflow_call: null }
permissions: { contents: read }
defaults: { run: { shell: "bash -euo pipefail {0}" } }

jobs:
  autofix:
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'kjanat/micro509' && github.actor != 'autofix-ci[bot]' && !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[autofix.ci]') && github.event.pull_request.stack == null }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup
        with: { install-bun: "true" }
      - uses: kjanat/runner@b32ea932a1813ae0be44e755c16df9f9f5ca86a4 # master
      # Custom catalog updates bypass Renovate's Bun lockfile updater.
      - name: Refresh Bun lockfile for Renovate
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'renovate[bot]' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
        run: bun install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
      - name: Install formatter and linter dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: run -s fmt:autofix lint:fix
      - uses: autofix-ci/action@c5b2d67aa2274e7b5a18224e8171550871fc7e4a # v1.3.4

name: Deploy Site

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      version: { type: string, required: true }
    secrets:
      CF_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL: { required: true }
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      channel:
        type: choice
        options: [next, bootstrap, repair]
        default: next
        description: Build next, initialize all snapshots, or repair one archive
      version:
        type: string
        description: Stable tag to repair (vX.Y.Z)

permissions: {}
concurrency: { group: docs-site, cancel-in-progress: false }

defaults: { run: { shell: "bash -euo pipefail {0}" } }

jobs:
  publish:
    if: github.repository == 'kjanat/micro509'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { contents: write }
    timeout-minutes: 60
    cancel-timeout-minutes: 5
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      REQUESTED_CHANNEL: ${{ inputs.channel }}
      RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
    steps:
      - name: Validate manual deployment ref
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref != 'refs/heads/master'
        run: |
          echo "::error::Run manual documentation deployments from master. Select an archive with the version input."
          exit 1
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref || inputs.version || github.sha }}
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup
        id: setup
        with: { install-bun: true, install-deno: true }
      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Restore published snapshots
        id: published
        run: |
          gh auth setup-git
          mkdir -p .publish
          previous=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/docs-site | cut -f1)
          echo "previous=${previous}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          if [[ -n "${previous}" ]]; then
            git fetch --depth=1 origin "${previous}"
            git archive FETCH_HEAD | tar -x -C .publish
          fi
      - name: Build selected documentation
        env:
          PREVIOUS: ${{ steps.published.outputs.previous }}
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${PREVIOUS}" ]]; then
            if [[ -n "${RELEASE_VERSION}" || "${REQUESTED_CHANNEL}" == repair ]]; then
              echo "::error::Initialize docs-site with a bootstrap run on master before releasing or repairing an archive."
              exit 1
            fi
            node scripts/docs-build.mjs --channel bootstrap --output .publish
          elif [[ "${REQUESTED_CHANNEL}" == repair ]]; then
            node scripts/docs-build.mjs --channel repair --version "${RELEASE_VERSION}" --output .publish
          elif [[ "${REQUESTED_CHANNEL}" == bootstrap ]]; then
            echo "::error::docs-site already exists. Use repair for a selected archive."
            exit 1
          elif [[ -n "${RELEASE_VERSION}" ]]; then
            node scripts/docs-build.mjs --channel release --version "${RELEASE_VERSION}" --output .publish
          else
            node scripts/docs-build.mjs --channel next --output .publish
          fi
      - name: Publish generated tree
        env:
          PREVIOUS: ${{ steps.published.outputs.previous }}
          GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: github-actions[bot]
          GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: github-actions[bot]
          GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
        run: |
          printf '%s:%s\n' "${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}" > .publish/publication-id.txt
          export GIT_INDEX_FILE="${RUNNER_TEMP}/docs-publish.index"
          git --work-tree=.publish add --all --force -- .
          tree=$(git write-tree)
          commit=$(printf 'Publish documentation for %s\n' "${GITHUB_SHA}" | git -c commit.gpgsign=false commit-tree "${tree}")
          git push --force-with-lease="refs/heads/docs-site:${PREVIOUS}" origin "${commit}:refs/heads/docs-site"

  deploy:
    needs: publish
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions: { contents: read }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with: { ref: docs-site, path: .published-docs, persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Deploy prebuilt tree to Cloudflare
        env:
          CF_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.CF_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL }}
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${CF_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL}" ]]; then
            echo "::error::CF_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL is required to deploy docs-site"
            exit 1
          fi
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --request POST "${CF_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL}" --output /dev/null
      - name: Verify production serves the published versioned documentation
        run: node scripts/check-docs-deployment.mjs .published-docs --live
files..github/workflows/pkg-pr-new.yml:
name: Publish Any Commit
on: { push: { branches: [master] }, pull_request: null }
permissions: {}
cache-mode: read
concurrency:
  group: pkgpr${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref || github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
defaults: { run: { shell: "bash -euo pipefail {0}" } }

jobs:
  build:
    if: github.repository == 'kjanat/micro509'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    cancel-timeout-minutes: 1
    permissions: { contents: read }
    steps:
      - { uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1, with: { persist-credentials: false } }
      - { uses: $/.github/actions/setup, id: setup, with: { install-bun: true, install-node: true } }
      - run: runner install -f build
      - id: pkg-pr
        timeout-minutes: 3
        continue-on-error: true # pkg.pr.new intermittently returns unrelated Cloudflare 500/1101 errors and hangs; previews are non-critical.
        run: |
          run -q publish:pkgprnew --json pkgpr.json
          meta="$(jq -c . pkgpr.json)"
          echo "meta=${meta}" | tee -a "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - { run: echo boo, if: always() }

# Repeats every test with randomized ordering to surface probabilistic bugs
# (wrong-key CBC padding flukes, raw-vs-DER ECDSA sniffing, and friends) that
# a single pass has a ~1/256-class chance of hitting.
---
name: Stress
on:
  schedule: [cron: "17 3 * * *"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      reruns:
        description: "Times to repeat each test (--rerun-each)"
        type: number
        default: 100
        required: false

permissions: {}

defaults: { run: { shell: "bash -euo pipefail {0}" } }

jobs:
  stress:
    name: Randomized rerun suite
    if: github.repository == 'kjanat/micro509'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    permissions: { contents: read }
    env: { RERUNS: "${{ inputs.reruns || '100' }}" }
    steps:
      - { uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1, with: { persist-credentials: false } }
      - { uses: $/.github/actions/setup, id: setup, with: { install-bun: "true", install-deno: "true" } }
      - name: Check stress test runtimes
        run: |
          bun --version
          deno --version
      - name: Install and build dist (root-barrel test imports the `micro509` package name)
        run: runner install -f build
      - name: Run suite with randomized order (failure output includes --seed for repro)
        run: bun test --randomize --concurrent --rerun-each="${RERUNS}"

# No `concurrency` here: when Publish calls this via workflow_call, `github.workflow`
# resolves to the caller ("Publish"), so a shared group would deadlock caller vs callee.
---
name: Test
on: { push: { branches: [master] }, pull_request: null, workflow_call: null }
permissions: {}

defaults: { run: { shell: "bash -euo pipefail {0}" } }

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: &U ubuntu-26.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions: { contents: &r read, id-token: write, attestations: *r }
    steps:
      - &checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - parallel:
          - uses: &TS $/.github/actions/setup
            id: setup
            with: { install-bun: true, install-node: true, install-deno: true }
          - uses: &SSL $/.github/actions/setup-openssl
      - name: Build (runs attw + publint + unused-export checks)
        run: runner install -f build
      - run: run typecheck
      - name: Argon2 TypeScript and WASM oracle parity
        run: run test:argon2:oracle
      - name: Deno lint + type-check + doc-lint (full source tree)
        run: run -p check:deno lint:deno docs:lint
      - run: run test:coverage
        env: { DIFFERENTIAL_OPENSSL: "1" }
      - name: Native WebCrypto coverage (Node)
        run: run test:coverage:native
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        if: &OG github.repository == 'kjanat/micro509'
        uses: &codecov codecov/codecov-action@a99c28d3f0da835de33ff2feb2e15691c7b9641f # v7
        with:
          flags: bun,node
          fail_ci_if_error: true
          use_oidc: true
          report_type: coverage
          files: coverage/lcov.info,coverage/native.lcov
      - name: Upload test-results to Codecov
        if: *OG
        uses: *codecov
        with: { flags: bun, fail_ci_if_error: true, use_oidc: true, report_type: test_results, files: test-results.xml }
      - parallel:
          - name: Node smoke test (dist)
            run: node scripts/smoke.mjs
          - name: Deno smoke test (dist)
            run: deno run --allow-read scripts/smoke.mjs

  docs:
    name: Docs site
    runs-on: *U
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions: { contents: *r }
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - uses: *TS
        id: setup
        with: { install-bun: true, install-node: true, install-deno: true }
      - run: runner install -f site:build
        env: { GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
      - name: Version switcher distinguishes preview and production destinations
        run: bun test ./site/.vitepress/theme/components/version-catalog.test.ts
      - name: Every version's examples import the library that version documents
        run: run site:import-maps
      - run: run playwright:chromium
      - name: Examples run in a browser, with a content blocker simulated
        run: run site:live-examples

  runtime-smoke:
    name: Workerd + browser smoke
    runs-on: *U
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions: { contents: *r, id-token: write }
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - uses: *TS
        id: setup
        with: { install-bun: true, install-node: true, install-deno: true }
      - run: runner install -sf bd playwright:chromium smoke
      - name: Setup Node without native Argon2
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with: { node-version: "22", package-manager-cache: false }
      - name: Argon2 fallback after native KeyFormat rejection
        run: run test:coverage:portable
      - name: Upload portable fallback coverage to Codecov
        if: *OG
        uses: *codecov
        with:
          flags: node22
          fail_ci_if_error: true
          use_oidc: true
          report_type: coverage
          files: coverage/portable.lcov

  differential:
    name: OpenSSL differential
    runs-on: *U
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions: { contents: *r, attestations: *r }
    env: { DIFFERENTIAL_OPENSSL: "1" }
    steps:
      - *checkout
      - parallel:
          - { uses: *TS, id: setup, with: { install-bun: "true" } }
          - { uses: *SSL }
      - run: runner install -f test:differential
files.README.md: # micro509 [![NPM](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/micro509?logo=npm&labelColor=CB3837&color=black)][npm] [![JSR](https://img.shields.io/jsr/v/@kjanat/micro509?logoColor=083344&logo=jsr&logoSize=auto&label=&labelColor=f7df1e&color=black)][jsr] [![Socket](https://badge.socket.dev/npm/package/micro509)][socket] A zero-dependency TypeScript X.509 and PKI toolkit. Create certificates and CSRs, verify certificate chains and identities, manage revocation, and work with keys and PKCS containers using WebCrypto. Zero dependencies. Tree-shakeable subpath entrypoints. Pure WebCrypto. Runs in Node, Bun, Deno, browsers, and Cloudflare Workers. `micro509/kdf` derives Argon2d, Argon2i, and Argon2id keys across supported runtimes, including versions `0x10` and `0x13`. > **Prerelease** — API may change before 1.0. ## Install ```bash npm install micro509 ``` ## Quick start Create a self-signed certificate, verify its chain and service identity, then see a typed failure when the requested identity does not match: ```ts import { createSelfSignedCertificate, verifyCertificateChain } from 'micro509'; const { certificate } = await createSelfSignedCertificate({ subject: { commonName: 'app.example.com' }, extensions: { subjectAltNames: [{ type: 'dns', value: 'app.example.com' }], }, }); const options = { leaf: certificate.pem, roots: [certificate.pem], allowSelfSignedLeaf: true, } as const; const valid = await verifyCertificateChain({ ...options, serviceIdentity: { type: 'dns', value: 'app.example.com' }, }); console.log(valid.ok ? 'verified app.example.com' : valid.error.code); const mismatch = await verifyCertificateChain({ ...options, serviceIdentity: { type: 'dns', value: 'admin.example.com' }, }); console.log(mismatch.ok ? 'verified' : mismatch.error.code); ``` Output: ```text verified app.example.com subject_alt_name_mismatch ``` A verification failure is a typed result with an error code, failing certificate index when relevant, and structured details. Callers can handle a specific case without parsing messages or collapsing every failure into `false`. The self-signed leaf option above is useful for a compact local demo. In production, supply the appropriate trust anchors and intermediates for your PKI. ## What it covers - **Certificates and CSRs:** create, parse, and encode common X.509 extensions - **Verification:** build and validate chains, enforce policy, and match DNS, IP, URI, and SRV service identities - **Revocation:** create and process CRLs and OCSP requests and responses - **Keys and signatures:** import, export, and generate RSA, ECDSA, and Ed25519 keys, plus signing and verification of detached data - **PKCS workflows:** PKCS#7 SignedData and password-protected PFX/PKCS#12 - **PEM and DER:** encode, decode, and parse common formats The root package exports the usual workflows: ```ts import { createCertificate, parseCertificatePem, verifyCertificateChain } from 'micro509'; ``` For smaller imports or more specialized types, use domain entrypoints: ```ts import { parseCertificatePem } from 'micro509/x509'; import { verifyCertificateChain } from 'micro509/verify'; import { checkCertificateRevocation } from 'micro509/revocation'; import { createPfx } from 'micro509/pkcs'; import { generateKeyPair } from 'micro509/keys'; ``` See the [API reference](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/api/) for the full entrypoint list. ## Standards and algorithms micro509 implements core certificate path validation, service identity, policy, PEM, safe-curve, OCSP, and PKCS container workflows. The exact claim boundary and partial areas are documented in the [PKIX scope](./docs/PKIX-SCOPE.md). See [algorithms](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/reference/algorithms) for supported curves and signature schemes, [runtimes](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/reference/runtimes) for environment support, and [standards](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/reference/standards) for implementation coverage. ## Try it in a browser The browser example is a single HTML file that issues a certificate and parses it back with no build step. The Vite example adds TypeScript and a dev server. - [Browser example][browser-example], [open in StackBlitz][browser-example:stackblitz] - [Vite example][vite-example], [open in StackBlitz][vite-example:stackblitz] ## Documentation - [Recipes: server verification, CSR issuance, PFX import](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/guide/recipes) - [Migration from 0.14.0](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/guide/migration) - [Getting started](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/guide/getting-started) - [Certificates and extensions](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/guide/certificates) - [Verification and trust inputs](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/guide/verification) - [CRL and OCSP revocation](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/guide/revocation) - [Keys and encrypted formats](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/guide/keys) - [PKCS#7 and PKCS#12](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/guide/pkcs) - [Error reference](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/reference/errors) - [API reference](https://micro509.kjanat.dev/api/) - [Contributing](./CONTRIBUTING.md) ## OpenSSL builds This repository also publishes statically linked OpenSSL builds to GHCR for micro509 CI and general use. /**
 * Stable root import for `micro509`.\
 * Re-exports the common certificate, parsing, verification, revocation, key, and PKCS
 * workflows from one package entrypoint.
 *
 * Reach for this module when you want the default workflow-first package surface.
 * Use domain entrypoints such as `micro509/x509`, `micro509/verify`, and
 * `micro509/revocation` when you need exhaustive advanced types.
 *
 * The root export is organized around common PKI flows:
 *
 * - create certificates, CSRs, CRLs, OCSP responses, PKCS#7, and PFX artifacts
 * - parse DER or PEM inputs into typed certificate and request shapes
 * - verify certificate chains, service identities, CRLs, OCSP, and signed data
 * - import, export, generate, and encrypt key material with WebCrypto-safe algorithms
 * - work with the common extension inputs, revocation evidence, and validation results
 *
 * Advanced PKCS#12 MAC plumbing, signature profile tuning, and other domain-specific helper
 * types stay in their owner domains instead of being headlined here.
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * import {
 * 	createSelfSignedCertificate,
 * 	parseCertificatePem,
 * 	unwrap,
 * 	verifyCertificateChain,
 * } from 'micro509';
 *
 * const { certificate } = await createSelfSignedCertificate({
 * 	subject: { commonName: 'example.com' },
 * 	algorithm: { kind: 'ecdsa', curve: 'P-256' },
 * });
 *
 * const parsed = unwrap(parseCertificatePem(certificate.pem));
 * // parsed.subject.values.commonName === 'example.com'
 *
 * const result = await verifyCertificateChain({
 * 	leaf: certificate.pem,
 * 	roots: [certificate.pem],
 * 	allowSelfSignedLeaf: true,
 * });
 * // result.ok === true
 * ```
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * import {
 * 	generateKeyPair,
 * 	parseCertificateSigningRequestPem,
 * 	createCertificateSigningRequest,
 * 	unwrap,
 * } from 'micro509';
 *
 * const keyPair = await generateKeyPair({ kind: 'ecdsa', curve: 'P-256' });
 * const csr = await createCertificateSigningRequest({
 * 	subject: { commonName: 'example.com' },
 * 	publicKey: keyPair.publicKey,
 * 	signerPrivateKey: keyPair.privateKey,
 * });
 *
 * const parsed = unwrap(parseCertificateSigningRequestPem(csr.pem));
 * // parsed.subject.values.commonName === 'example.com'
 * ```
 *
 * @module micro509
 */

export type {
	DecryptRsaOaepErrorCode,
	DecryptRsaOaepFailure,
	DecryptRsaOaepResult,
	EcKeyAlgorithmInput,
	EcNamedCurve,
	Ed25519KeyAlgorithmInput,
	EncryptedPkcs8Options,
	EncryptRsaOaepErrorCode,
	EncryptRsaOaepFailure,
	EncryptRsaOaepResult,
	ImportEcKeyInput,
	ImportEd25519KeyInput,
	ImportEncryptedKeyErrorCode,
	ImportEncryptedKeyFailure,
	ImportEncryptedKeyOptions,
	ImportEncryptedKeyResult,
	ImportKeyErrorCode,
	ImportKeyFailure,
	ImportKeyResult,
	ImportRsaKeyInput,
	KdfLimitOptions,
	KeyAlgorithmInput,
	KeyPairMaterial,
	LegacyPemEncryptionOptions,
	Pbes2Parameters,
	PrivateKeyImportInput,
	PublicKeyImportInput,
	RsaHash,
	RsaKeyAlgorithmInput,
	RsaOaepOptions,
	RsaScheme,
	RsaSignatureScheme,
} from '#micro509/keys';
export {
	decryptRsaOaep,
	decryptRsaOaepOrThrow,
	derivePublicKey,
	encryptRsaOaep,
	encryptRsaOaepOrThrow,
	exportBinaryBase64,
	exportEncryptedPkcs1Pem,
	exportEncryptedPkcs8Der,
	exportEncryptedPkcs8Pem,
	exportEncryptedSec1Pem,
	exportPkcs1Der,
	exportPkcs1Pem,
	exportPkcs8Der,
	exportPkcs8Pem,
	exportPrivateJwk,
	exportPublicJwk,
	exportSec1Der,
	exportSec1Pem,
	exportSpkiDer,
	exportSpkiPem,
	generateKeyPair,
	importEncryptedPkcs1Pem,
	importEncryptedPkcs1PemOrThrow,
	importEncryptedPkcs8Der,
	importEncryptedPkcs8DerOrThrow,
	importEncryptedPkcs8Pem,
	importEncryptedPkcs8PemOrThrow,
	importEncryptedSec1Pem,
	importEncryptedSec1PemOrThrow,
	importPkcs1Der,
	importPkcs1DerOrThrow,
	importPkcs1Pem,
	importPkcs1PemOrThrow,
	importPkcs8Base64,
	importPkcs8Base64OrThrow,
	importPkcs8Der,
	importPkcs8DerOrThrow,
	importPkcs8Pem,
